description: Rebuilds a towing quote or invoice from its own terms: base fee, distance covered by the base fee, total distance, rate per mile or per kilometer, and other fees. Every rate comes from the quote being checked. Returns the result of the repairworth.com engine unchanged: `billableMiles`, `mileageCents`, `totalCents`, and the flags `totalIsPartial` (other fees unknown) and `mileageRounded`. Distances come back in miles and amounts in integer US cents. The tool holds no market price and no typical range: it does not say what the work should cost or whether a price is fair. An input the engine refuses comes back with `valid: false` and the engine's own messages.

base.description: Base or hook-up fee on the towing quote. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

fees.description: Optional. Other fees on the quote (storage, winching, after-hours). When it is left out the total is flagged as partial. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

includedDistance.description: Distance covered by the base fee. 0 when none is included. In the unit given by `unit`, with at most two decimals when sent as a string.

perDistance.description: Rate per mile or per kilometer on the towing quote. US dollars with at most two decimals: a number, or a string such as "85", "85.50" or "$1,234.50".

totalDistance.description: Total distance of the tow. In the unit given by `unit`, with at most two decimals when sent as a string.

unit.description: Unit of the two distances and of the rate: miles or kilometers.

name: towing_estimate
title: Rebuild a Towing Quote
